tools.name: find_parcel
tools.description: Find the titled lot (ParcelMap BC parcel) for a BC street address, a PID, the plan in a legal description ("Lot 5, Plan KAP12345", or the old form with its land district, "KDYD, Plan 1234"), or a point. Returns each lot's PID (for parcel_report), plan, mapped area and report page. Only an exact civi

tools.name: parcel_report
tools.description: One lot's report by PID: for each section a status (flag = look into, clear = nothing to flag, info = for reference, gap = not covered here, error = not available yet) and a one-line answer; for the sections named, also the facts behind it, notes, and sources with licences. Sections: zoning, buildab
